name: Tessera
blurb: Tessera generates digital mosaics (QR codes) from any text or URL, with full control over how they look and where they end up.
description:
Tessera generates digital mosaics (QR codes) from any text or URL,
with full control over how they look and where they end up.

Features:

• Live preview as you type

• Custom foreground color, with a warning if contrast is too low to scan reliably

• Four error correction levels (Low, Medium, High, Quartile)

• Export as PNG or SVG

• Copy to clipboard from the menu or with a single click on the mosaic

• Persistent preferences for default color and error correction level

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
